4164.title: Native project skills remain in the injected plugin
4164.rootCauseOneLine: The bridge injects the entire staged skill directory while enabling native project discovery; the SDK lists the same project skill under both names.
4164.proposedFix: Validate session-specific native visibility before filtering injected skills.
4164.caveats: Home fixture listed one name; token overhead and truncation unverified. No safe automatic fix established.
